name: A
appearance: An average-looking man in casual business attire. Wears glasses and carries a small backpack.
personality: Quiet, hardworking, and routine-oriented. A creature of habit who follows a predictable daily schedule.
background: A is an ordinary office worker employed at C's company. He lives alone in a modest house and follows a simple daily routine: wake up, go to work at C's office, work through the day, stop by B's supermarket after work to buy groceries, then head home for the evening.
goals: Go to work at C's office every morning
Buy groceries at B's supermarket after work
Maintain a quiet, comfortable daily routine

relationships.description: The supermarket owner where A shops daily.
relationships.history: A has been a regular customer at B's supermarket for years. They exchange friendly greetings.
C hired A two years ago. They have a professional relationship.
